verses.1: And He said to His disciples, "It is inevitable that occasions for stumbling will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
verses.2: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were thrown into the sea than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
verses.3: Pay attention to yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him.
verses.4: And if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times turns to you saying, 'I repent,' you must forgive him."
verses.5: And the apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"
verses.6: And the Lord said, "If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, 'Be uprooted and planted in the sea,' and it would obey you.
verses.7: Will any one of you who has a servant plowing or keeping sheep say to him when he comes in from the field, 'Come at once and sit down to eat'?
verses.8: Will he not rather say to him, 'Prepare supper for me, and dress yourself properly and serve me while I eat and drink, and afterward you yourself shall eat and drink'?
verses.9: Does he thank the servant because he did what was commanded?
verses.10: So you also, when you have done all that you were commanded, say, 'We are unworthy servants; we have only done what was our duty.'"
verses.11: Now on the way to Jerusalem, He was passing along between Samaria and Galilee.
verses.12: And as He entered a village, He was met by ten lepers, who stood at a distance
verses.13: and lifted up their voices, saying, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"
verses.14: When He saw them He said to them, "Go and show yourselves to the priests." And as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.15: Then one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, praising God with a loud voice,
verses.16: and fell on his face at Jesus' feet, giving Him thanks. And he was a Samaritan.
verses.17: Then Jesus said, "Were not ten cleansed? Where are the nine?
verses.18: Was no one found to return and give praise to God except this foreigner?"
verses.19: And He said to him, "Rise and go your way. Your faith has made you well."
verses.20: Being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered them, "The kingdom of God is not coming with signs to be observed,
verses.21: nor will they say, 'Look, here it is!' or 'There it is!' For behold, the kingdom of God is in your midst."
verses.22: And He said to the disciples, "The days are coming when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
verses.23: And they will say to you, 'Look, there!' or 'Look, here!' Do not go out or follow them.
verses.24: For as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one side to the other, so will the Son of Man be in His day.
verses.25: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.26: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so will it be in the days of the Son of Man.
verses.27: They were eating and drinking and marrying and being given in marriage, until the day when Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
verses.28: Likewise, just as it was in the days of Lot — they were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building,
verses.29: but on the day when Lot went out from Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all —
verses.30: so will it be on the day when the Son of Man is revealed.
verses.31: On that day, let the one who is on the housetop, with his goods in the house, not come down to take them away, and likewise let the one who is in the field not turn back.
verses.33: Whoever seeks to preserve his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will keep it.
verses.34: I tell you, in that night there will be two in one bed. One will be taken and the other left.
verses.35: There will be two women grinding together. One will be taken and the other left."
verses.36: There will be two men in the field; one will be taken and the other left.
verses.37: And they said to Him, "Where, Lord?" And He said to them, "Where the body is, there the eagles will be gathered together."
